Theorem 1 (Chapter 131)

Subject: dynamical systems | ID: 73657

Step 3. By compactness of the trace-free spectral family \(U_{01310013}\), the image is precompact in the Riemann surface topology.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via iterative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
